parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: The product to which the resource belongs. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified product. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied.

parameters.name: ResourceCategoryId
parameters.description: The resource category ID. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. Separate multiple resource category IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data of the current logon account is returned.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID where the resource resides. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified region. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,).
